column1: # CHAOS-13243: workflows whose red main-push run opens one main-red issue (ci/venue-main-alert.sh).
# name = exact workflow name (workflow_run.name); must equal the name: of the file and the workflow_run list in venue-oracles-main-alert.yml.
# cancelled: red = a cancelled run opens the issue (venue-oracles); ignore = it does not open and does not close (main runs are sha-keyed, never cancelled by a newer push; a cancel is manual).
# witnesses: ";"-separated job-name prefixes. A success run closes the issue only if every witness has jobs and all of them executed (success). - = the venue step proof of ci/last-venue-run.sh.
# legacy_label: label of an issue opened before CHAOS-13243; found and updated, - = none.
